decisive_items: sudden cardiac death at a young age
ECG Findings:- First episode showed complete atrioventricular block with inferior ST-segment elevation (heart rate 45 bpm)- Second episode showed junctional escape rhythm (heart rate 32 bpm)
response.rationale: The patient's family history of sudden cardiac death and the ECG findings of inferior ST-segment elevation are more suggestive of Brugada Syndrome than the other options, despite the normal genetic testing results.

rejected.why: The ECG findings do not support Long QT Syndrome.
